description: Bypass-Caliptra flash image (A1's default): SoC firmware and its NPCM header only, so it needs nothing from caliptra-mcu-sw. The A1 ROM's bypass SoC path verifies just these two slots and loads the SoC firmware itself; with oMcuFwEn=1 it finds no MCU runtime and falls back to the same path. Partition table at 0, single valid slot A at slot_base_offset.
